soldier: Head yellowish brown and covered with short pubescence, the tips of the mandibles reddish brown, thorax and abdomen yellowish white. Head nearly trapezoidal, the lateral margins slightly oblique backwards, widest beside the base of the mandibles, the anterior margin straight, the posterior margin broadly rounded; labrum semicircular with its tip distinctly concave; mandibles hooked, each with a large blunt tooth at one-third, and one small sharp tooth above the base of each, projecting above the molar plate like a small tooth; antennae with 14 segments, the second about as long as the third, the fourth shortest; the waist of the postmentum 0.28 mm wide, its anterior margin straight; pronotum saddle-shaped, its posterior margin straight and depressed in the middle.
